run_video_model_training: run the Timesformer main entry point to train a video classification model using a config file
run_video_model_testing: run the Timesformer main entry point to test a pretrained video classification model using a config file
run_multi_gpu_training: run distributed training across multiple GPUs by setting NUM_GPUS in the config file
run_multi_clip_testing: run multi-clip testing on a pretrained video model by enabling TEST.ENABLE in config
run_tensorboard_visualization: run TensorBoard model visualization by enabling TENSORBOARD.MODEL_VIS in the config file
